Step 7 of the ticket workflow. One of the two real AI skills in this repo.
The skill asks an LLM to act as the assigned specialist and produce a
diagnosis (root cause + diagnostic steps + customer-safe solution) for an
escalated ticket.

## Layout

```text
skills/investigate-specialist-solution/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
└── scripts/
    └── investigate_specialist_solution.py
```

## Install

The single repo-root `install.sh` registers every skill at once (auto-discovers
any folder under `skills/` that has a `SKILL.md`):

```bash
bash install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "What did the specialist find for TKT-00042?"

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, verifies the escalation row exists, runs the script,
and reports the root cause, solution, customer action, and confidence.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/investigate-specialist-solution/scripts/investigate_specialist_solution.py \
    --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script expects `TRITONAI_API_KEY` in `.env`, `~/.env`, or the shell. It
calls the model through `utils.connect.ask_json()`, the same helper used by
the FAQ skill. Use `--model` to override the default model id.

The script writes `data/working/specialist_solutions.csv` and appends to
`data/working/ticket_action_log.csv`.

## Public functions

- `load_investigation_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket,
  escalation, specialist, triage, and systems dictionary; raises `LookupError`
  if no escalation or unknown specialist.
- `build_llm_prompt(context)` — JSON prompt sent to the LLM.
- `call_llm_for_specialist_solution(context, model)` — calls the LLM and
  returns the parsed JSON dict. Honours `SPECIALIST_INVESTIGATION_MOCK_JSON`
  for offline tests.
- `normalize_llm_solution(raw, context)` — validates the model's response,
  applies the missing-information confidence cap, and produces the workflow's
  decision fields.
- `build_solution_row(context, model)` — end-to-end row for
  `specialist_solutions.csv`.
- `write_specialist_solution(out_dir, solution)`.
- `main(argv)` — CLI entrypoint. Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 missing ticket/data,
  3 missing upstream escalation, 4 LLM call failed.

## Algorithm

1. Load the ticket, the upstream escalation, the chosen specialist row, and
   the latest triage decision.
2. Build a structured prompt summarising the ticket, triage, escalation, and
   specialist profile.
3. Ask the LLM for one JSON object describing the diagnosis.
4. Validate the response. Cap confidence at `0.60` if the escalation flagged
   missing customer information.
5. Write a row to `specialist_solutions.csv` and an action-log entry.

## Refusal behaviour

The script refuses to investigate when:

- there is no `escalation_decisions.csv` row for the ticket (route to
  `escalate-to-specialist` first), or
- the escalation references an unknown specialist id.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_investigate_specialist_solution.py -v
```
